occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

occurrences.checkable_against: Campaign advertisements, public statements and Federal Election Commission records for Adam Hamilton and Roger Marshall
occurrences.quote_span: Hamilton has attacked Marshall over his connection to Trump and the unpopular war in Iran, while Marshall has aimed to paint Hamilton as “woke,” claiming he supports a socially liberal approach to Christian theology.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal Election Commission candidate filings and Senate service records
occurrences.quote_span: Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas is running for the seat being vacated by Sen. Jeanne Shaheen (D-N.H.), while former Sen. John Sununu, a Republican who served one term in the chamber 18 years ago, is looking for a comeback.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

occurrences.checkable_against: Published 2026 Kansas Senate polls and U.S. Senate election results
occurrences.quote_span: Polls show Hamilton and Marshall neck and neck, significant for a state that hasn’t sent a Democrat to the Senate in nearly a century.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

occurrences.checkable_against: Published 2026 North Carolina Senate election polls
occurrences.quote_span: Former Gov. Roy Cooper, a Democrat, has been polling significantly ahead of Republican political operative Michael Whatley for much of the summer.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

occurrences.checkable_against: Cook Political Report 2026 Senate race ratings
occurrences.quote_span: The Cook Political Report, an election handicapper, is shifting its odds for Senate races in Kansas, North Carolina and New Hampshire toward Democrats.
occurrences.speaker: The Cook Political Report
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal Election Commission candidate filings and campaign records for the 2026 Kansas Senate race
occurrences.quote_span: Adam Hamilton, a pastor and founder of the largest United Methodist church in the country, is running as a moderate Democrat, hoping to unseat Sen. Roger Marshall (R-Kansas).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

evidence.title: Three Senate races shift toward Democrats in Cook ratings

occurrences.checkable_against: The Cook Political Report's October 6, 2026 ratings and race-rating archive for the 2026 U.S. Senate election
occurrences.quote_span: The Cook Political Report shifted its rating of three Senate races toward the left Tuesday, upgrading the chances that Democrats will win control of the Republican-held chamber in November.
occurrences.speaker: The Cook Political Report
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election
